description.en:
Seedling
Write a small widget in QML, preview it and save it to the widget. Describe it and an AI writes it (set it up in Seedling Settings); with MHCP-YUI installed, just ask Yui.
description.zh:
Seedling 萌芽
用 QML 写一个小挂件，预览，保存到挂件。描述一下，AI 就会写出来（在 Seedling Settings 里设置）；装了 MHCP-YUI 时，直接跟结衣说就行。
